items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: It was like Khrushchev and the five year plan.

ctx.x: Hopefully somebody will do a book on him.

Yeah. They will. There is a French book on him, I was interviewed, while he was still alive, years ago, there was a French biography. But he was like a guy with a master plan. I saw it. It was like Khrushchev and the five year plan. He had this whole thing mapped out and nothing was going to stand in his way. He as this quiet, self-effacing man who was like a bull. He had a will of iron. Never raised his voice. Always got what he wanted. If you can tame Milt Jackson and Kenny Clarke, you’re strong. And that’s…
There’s a record, the last concert, there’s a moment on that record, a song called “One Never Knows”—
